vectors.name: Murray Rothbard
vectors.comments: American economist, historian, and political theorist. Rothbard was a leading figure in the development of modern libertarianism and anarcho-capitalism. He advocated for a stateless society based on voluntary exchange and private property, and he was a strong critic of government intervention in the economy.

vectors.name: Javier Milei
vectors.comments: Argentine economist, author, and politician. Milei is known for his libertarian views and his advocacy for free-market economics. He has been a vocal critic of government intervention and has promoted policies that emphasize individual liberty, limited government, and economic freedom.

vectors.name: Elon Musk
vectors.comments: South African-born American entrepreneur and business magnate. Musk is the founder, CEO, and chief engineer of SpaceX; early investor, CEO, and product architect of Tesla, Inc.; founder of The Boring Company; co-founder of Neuralink; and co-founder and initial co-chairman of OpenAI. He is known for his work in advancing technology and innovation, particularly in the fields of space exploration, electric vehicles, and renewable energy.
